sources.title: An inequality for univalent functions with real coefficients
sources.inspection: Recovered full original issue independently byte-verified; complete printed A68 visually read. No full proof is supplied in the announcement.
sources.supports: Exact argument bound for (1-z^2)f'(z), with two branches in q. This is a different functional from A_f.
sources.priority_outcome: No target implication established from the recovered theorem. Explicit normalized real locally univalent countermodel satisfies the envelope but has |A|^2>81/5. It is not globally univalent and is not a PR counterexample.
